title: DEWY Receipt
description: Canonical receipt schema for the ARCS Orient surface (L5 output). Governing authority: arcs-field-os/specs/orient-prd.md v0.1.0. All implementation in arcs-v9 must conform to this schema. Breaking changes require a new file: dewy-receipt-schema-v2.json.

receipt_id.description: Unique receipt identifier. Format: ARCS-ORIENT-[ISO8601 timestamp]-[8-char hash]

surface.description: Which ARCS surface produced this receipt. For this schema: always ORIENT.

version.description: Schema version this receipt conforms to.

sharp_question.description: The atomic decision question produced by L0 Question Sharpener. Single sentence, ≤280 characters. Confirmed by user before L1 fires.

dewy_vector.description: DEWY state vector — the ARCS coordinate for this decision. Populated by L1 Decomposition.

D.description: Decision — the atomic question in action form, extracted from sharp_question.

E.description: Entity — who or what else is in the terrain.

other.description: Other entities in the decision terrain. Compressed to primary + secondary if >10 named.

entity_overflow.description: Entities compressed out of the primary E-field due to OM (exhaustive list). Present only when overflow occurred.

W.description: Window — time horizon. When does this decision lock?

horizon.description: Canonical time horizon. Inferred from question or PrepSession window field.

lock_date.description: Hard lock date if stated or inferable (ISO 8601 date). Absent if unknown.

inferred.description: True if horizon was auto-inferred (not explicitly provided). Logged when W-field inference ran.

Y.description: Yellow Gate — conviction gradient. Where is the user on the decision manifold?

polarity.description: Y-gate polarity state. See orient-prd.md §3 L2 for full definitions.

conviction.description: Conviction level within the polarity state.

stability.description: Stability mode — how rapidly is the conviction gradient changing?

y_gate_score.description: Y-gate scoring output from L2. Mirror of dewy_vector.Y plus render artifacts.

render_resolution.description: Render resolution emitted by L2 based on Y state. Maps to visual treatment in WORLD.md Render Scale.

visual_treatment.description: CSS visual treatment for the Brief at this render resolution.

nci_score.description: Network Coherence Index from L3. Five-lens scoring (0-100 composite).

composite.description: Sum of all five lens scores. <40 = HOLD. 40-59 = proceed with warning. 60-79 = DEGRADED render. 80-100 = SHARP render.

grade.description: Human-readable grade string with weakest lens called out. E.g. 'B+ — Conviction is the weak lens.'

true_north.description: Single directional sentence produced by L4. The bearing. E.g. 'Take the Company X offer.'

why.description: Supporting bullets for true_north. 1-5 items. Each is a distinct factual or structural reason.

loki.description: L (Loki) branch of the LAB macro. The strongest argument that true_north is wrong. Always present — synthesized internally even if PrepSession contra field was absent.

bar.description: BAR macro output from L4: Baseline ruin risk / Asymmetry / Reversibility.

ruin_risk.description: Worst-case outcome if true_north is wrong. Prefixed with risk level: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / EXISTENTIAL.

asymmetry.description: Is the upside/downside asymmetric? In which direction?

reversibility.description: Can this decision be unwound? At what cost and in what window?

render_resolution.description: Top-level render resolution for the Brief. Driven by y_gate_score.render_resolution. Determines visual treatment and fidelity header.

fidelity_header.description: Optional. Present when render_resolution != SHARP. Human-readable fidelity caveat shown at top of Brief. E.g. 'This brief renders at 85% fidelity — conviction gradient is still SHIFTING.'

inferred_fields.description: Fields that were auto-inferred (not explicitly provided). Logged for transparency. E.g. ['stakes', 'W.horizon', 'Y']

collision_fields.description: Fields where two or more valid parses existed and a collision was detected. Logged when HOLD was triggered and resolved.

validation_state.description: Final HOLD/REJECT gate state. Only PASS receipts reach L5. HOLD and REJECT are logged but do not produce a full receipt.

horizon.description: Top-level convenience field mirroring dewy_vector.W.horizon. For indexing and filtering.

stakes.description: Stakes level from PrepSession or auto-inferred.

mode.description: Evaluation mode. QUICKMOVE = fast, low-stakes. PLAN = structured. COURT = adversarial, high-stakes.

clarity_mode.description: Output verbosity mode. SIMPLE = 1 True North + ≤3 bullets. RICH = Simple + visual. DEEP = full work shown.

macros_run.description: Which macros fired during this session.

session_ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this receipt was generated (L5 freeze time).

drift_state.description: Drift Sentinel state at time of receipt. LOCKED = Kairos Lock active. LANDED = artifact produced and session closed.

prep_session_id.description: Optional. ID of the PrepSession that seeded this receipt, if one was used.

parent_receipt_id.description: Optional. If this receipt is a re-run or refinement of a prior session, links to the parent.
